name: Uzziel
title: Levitical clan head
summary: Uzziel was the son of Kohath and grandson of Levi, thus an important patriarch in the Levite lineage. He was the father of several sons, including Mishael, Elzaphan, and Zithri. His descendants, the Uzzielites, had important duties related to tabernacle service and temple service in Israel.

keyEvents.title: Uzziel's Place in Levi's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Uzziel is mentioned as the fourth and youngest son of Kohath, son of Levi, in the genealogy in Exodus.

keyEvents.title: Uzziel's Sons Are Mentioned
keyEvents.description: Uzziel's three sons Mishael, Elzaphan, and Zithri are mentioned in connection with the Levites' genealogy.

keyEvents.title: Elzaphan Appointed Leader of the Kohathites
keyEvents.description: Uzziel's son Elzaphan was appointed by Moses as leader of the Kohathite families, who were responsible for the holy items in the tabernacle.

keyEvents.title: Mishael and Elzaphan Carry Away Nadab and Abihu
keyEvents.description: Uzziel's sons Mishael and Elzaphan were called by Moses to carry the dead bodies of Nadab and Abihu out of the camp after they were struck down by the Lord's fire.

keyEvents.title: The Uzzielites in 1 Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Uzziel's descendants, the Uzzielites, are mentioned in connection with the Levites' service divisions during King David's reign.

keyEvents.title: The Uzzielites in Temple Service
keyEvents.description: Uzziel's descendants participated in the cleansing of the temple during King Hezekiah's reforms.
